# EcoStorage

> EcoStorage is a full-service pickup-and-delivery storage company serving personal and corporate customers across Singapore. The company collects, stores, and redelivers belongings on the customer's schedule — customers never visit a facility themselves — using recycled-pallet and wooden-crate storage methods that run at ambient (not air-conditioned) temperature for a lower carbon footprint than traditional 24/7 air-conditioned self-storage.

EcoStorage operates 13 islandwide locations in Singapore and has served the market for 8 years. Facility/warehouse addresses are not published; the public contact address is 7030 Ang Mo Kio Ave 5, #08-94, Singapore 569880.

## Services

- [Personal storage](https://www.storagespace.com.sg/personal): pickup, storage, and on-demand delivery for households — dorm move-outs, full-home decluttering, and life transitions.
- [Corporate storage](https://www.storagespace.com.sg/corporate): records/document archiving, inventory and pallet storage, and asset storage with account management.
- [All services](https://www.storagespace.com.sg/services): pickup & storage, on-demand delivery, records management, inventory storage.
- [Storage pricing calculator](https://www.storagespace.com.sg/): instant quotes by unit size, commitment period, and delivery add-ons, with environmental savings (CO2 and trees saved) shown alongside pricing.
